Former Tamil Nadu Minister Nehru, 12 Others Booked for Tender Irregularities

The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) in Tamil Nadu has booked former minister K N Nehru and 12 others in connection with alleged tender irregularities. Nehru is named as the prime accused in a case involving ₹1,020 crore. His brothers, K N Manivannan and N Ravichandran, are also named and accused of coordinating the collection and routing of illegal gratification. The DVAC has filed a case against them.
